description:
*From [INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/557-the-ceo-s-new-clothes):*     
When Myung-hae goes for an interview, she is shocked to see the director, Chan Lee, naked before her. Only she can see Chan Lee without his clothes, while he can read other people's thoughts.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Kakaopage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54478290), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4879105), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/naked_a_D), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020005085), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=39ha), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/rockin_sr_0020)
